method: Retrospective 16 NBA opening games retrieved Basketball-Reference period play-by-play pages using connected webpage-extract service. Parse native markdown event rows and count shots, FT, turnover, rebound, substitution and foul action strings by team and quarter; strict period-end scoreboard and points = 2*FGM + 3PM + FTM matching archived game-quarter scores. Source page mutable; not an independently timestamped prospective snapshot. No third-party raw play text archived.
caveats: PBP source is Basketball-Reference, not independently NBA CDN compared for all games
Raw HTML/source bytes not preserved; Git blob freezes transformed derived event counts only
Counts of rebound Team may not correspond to traditional possession estimate; FOUL flags not a verified foul count
Turnover by players/team and steals in text are side-relative, not verified causal defensive assignments
No actual lineup 5-man rotations or exact on-floor minute totals derived
No sportsbook market price or predicted probability / EV
